summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login  **What I already checked (read-only, no edits):** - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — every route requires a valid session cookie/token, resolves `X-User-Id` from the session, and every query is scoped `WHERE user_id = ?`. This part looks correct. - `db/auth.ts` — login always resolves to the *same* `user.id` for a given email (no re-creation of users on login), sessions map token → stable user_id. Also looks correct. - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` — all reads/writes go through `api.get/post/delete("/watchlist...")`
